sahneler.metin: Europe's Schiaparelli lander crashed on Mars.
It fell from high above the surface and was destroyed.
As its parachute opened, the lander spun hard.
A rotation sensor maxed out for about a second.
The software combined that bad value with other data.
It calculated an altitude below the ground.
So it released the parachute and fired its thrusters only briefly.
ESA improved how later landers handle saturated sensors.

aciklama:
Schiaparelli crashed on Mars. The cause: saturated inertial measurement unit leading software to compute a negative altitude.

#shorts #engineering #software
